text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Splendid, Trainer-kun...! That was some truly dazzling button work!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I have so many plushies in my hands now... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If we had this many back then, I might have given them to Brian without any fighting.
choice_data_list: It's not too late even now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...?
Still, for us to have matching plushies right now—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...No, that might actually be interesting.
Heh, I think I'll pitch that next time.
